title: Real 44px controls
summary: The small text links become real controls: "Vzdát se a ukázat odpovědi" is a dark-blue tone button, the footer links are full 44px rows, the Mimo tabuli names become grey chips like the ones above them, the wordmark gets a 44px box and "Odhlásit se" becomes a grey button.
tradeoffs: Clearly tappable and passes the 44px guideline by measurement, but "Vzdát se" becomes more prominent (tempting to quit early) and the footer list gets taller.
